output.summary: A small herb native to the British Isles, Europe, North Africa, Turkey and Iran, it may be annual, biennial or a short-lived perennial. It has mostly basal leaves with rounded leaflets, tiny white flowers and fruits that generally remain below the flowers.
output.edibilityNote: In Manipur it is reportedly eaten as an aromatic herb and eromba garnish, but the source marks this claim as needing a citation.
